description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source project. It manages displaying and searching test cases and test suites, including handling user permissions, initializing environment variables, processing test case details, and performing system-wide test case searches. It supports use cases like viewing test specifications and searching for test cases across projects.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case data and operations, including retrieving versions, info, and displaying test cases.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data, including retrieving project options and identifiers.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class managing platform data related to test cases.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: Class managing code tracking and integration with test projects.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates request arguments, manages user permissions, and sets environment variables for test case operations.

methods.name: initializeEnv
methods.description: Sets up environment variables, user grants, and GUI configuration for test case pages.

methods.name: systemWideTestCaseSearch
methods.description: Performs a search for test cases across projects based on user input, handling prefixes and test case IDs.

methods.name: getSettingFromFormNameSpace
methods.description: Retrieves specific settings from session data based on mode and setting name.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Handles displaying detailed test case information, including version management, attachments, and search forms.
